title: Short accepted rainfall trajectory with native ponding/runoff thresholds
purpose: Determine whether the D22 native FMC surface-threshold response propagates through a short storm and post-storm redistribution trajectory at least as faithfully as the admitted R2 coarse-Richards comparator, without forcing threshold equivalence to R16.

predecessor_authority.D15: Full FMC atmospheric-side finite-volume accounting preflight passed.
predecessor_authority.D16: FMC surface infiltration/hiatus redistribution beats R2 on the bounded prescribed-infiltration development views.
predecessor_authority.D20: FMC one-hour fixed-water-table persistence retains research candidacy.
predecessor_authority.D21: Matched R16/FMC rainfall regime labels fail at 2 Ksat before trajectory exposure; no threshold retuning is authorized.
predecessor_authority.D22: FMC native one-step threshold response is competitive with R2 on all preregistered native surface-response views while remaining non-equivalent to R16.
predecessor_authority.interpretation: D23 preserves native threshold displacement and tests its multi-step hydrological consequences.

common_initial_state.connected_front_depths: linear from z_101=120 cm to z_199=10 cm
common_initial_state.R16_R2_mapping: exact D16 finite-volume mapping of the same FMC profile into 10-cm and 80-cm cell averages

histories.interpretation: common native no-runoff/low-supply control from the D22 ladder
known native threshold-mismatch case: R16 ponded/no-runoff in D21/D22 one-step response while R2/FMC are already on the runoff side
common active-runoff regime control from the D22 ladder

top_boundary_per_interval: read committed top-cell theta and pressure head
set previous_ponding_depth to the separately tracked accepted surface store from the preceding interval
set precipitation_rate to frozen factor*Ksat for steps 1..16 and zero for steps 17..64
iterate current-canonical evaluate_b110_dynamic_top_boundary from candidate ponding=previous store until bitwise fixed or absolute candidate change <=1e-14 cm, maximum 32 iterations
require provider availability, finite outputs and surface water ledger closure
materialize provider actual_top_flux_cm_per_day as the explicit top flux for exactly one accepted Reference soil-water interval
commit the soil-water candidate through the existing kernel owner
publish provider candidate ponding as the external accepted surface store and accumulate provider runoff_depth
R16_R2_route.numerical_authority: D4 strict-first integrated-water-depth research reattempt policy; hard accepted transaction soil-water mass gate 1e-12 cm; no production tolerance change.
R16_R2_route.note: Surface store is a research-comparator state tracked outside the fixed-flux Reference kernel because D23 tests pre-resolved current-canonical dynamic-top semantics without changing production state ownership.

connected_phase_per_interval: available surface water = previous accepted surface store + rainfall depth
advance every existing connected bin by the D14/D16 Eq.18 potential front advance
allocate available water left-to-right by D15 finite-volume accounting; no new dry-bin activation is expected because I_DEEP already has active bins 101..199
route residual surface water through the frozen D22 ponding/runoff reservoir law
FMC_route.hiatus_transition: On a zero-rain interval whose accepted residual surface store is <=1e-14 cm, detach every connected interval [0,z_j] to a falling slug with identical water volume at the END of that interval. No slug translation occurs until the next interval.
FMC_route.detached_hiatus_phase: Translate every falling slug by the D14 Eq.19 velocity for one 10-s interval; preserve each slug length exactly; no new surface-connected front is created.
FMC_route.forbidden_events: Any slug collision/overlap, bottom-boundary contact, nonfinite state, front/slug leaving 0..160 cm, or ledger failure is fail-closed.

checks: all 64 intervals complete under the frozen FMC route
every interval surface+soil ledger closes within 1e-12 cm
global rain = final soil storage change + final surface store + cumulative runoff within 1e-12 cm
all connected fronts and falling slugs remain inside 0..160 cm
no collision, overlap, clipping, dry-bin retuning or full-order fallback occurs
FMC_internal_preflight.failure_rule: If the FMC-only preflight fails, close D23 before generating any R16/R2 trajectory. No factor, duration, surface parameter, bin, process step, Eq.18/Eq.19 rule or detachment rule may be retuned.

outputs_per_interval: bottom exchange and bottom flux diagnostic
Richards nonlinear work and research reattempt count

comparison_metrics.R2_profile_mapping: repeat each 80-cm R2 cell-average theta across the corresponding eight R16 10-cm cells

all_required: FMC-only preflight passes before any Richards trajectory generation
all R05/R20/R40 R16, R2 and FMC trajectories complete with integrity

interpretation_boundary.if_positive: Retain FMC for short rainfall/ponding/runoff trajectory research relative to R2. D21 native threshold non-equivalence remains true. Longer rainfall+groundwater composition and same-runtime performance remain separate.
interpretation_boundary.if_negative: Do not retune native FMC thresholds or surface parameters. Preserve FMC candidacy only for already qualified D13-D20 envelopes and any D22 one-step relative frontier that remains scientifically relevant.
interpretation_boundary.neither_outcome: No application acceptance, production ROM authority, ET/root-uptake fidelity, seasonal balance or formal speedup claim.
